units.source_text: “她的能耐真不错呢：即使是她所不擅长的事，为了我就不惜辛苦地去做。

en.t: She really was quite capable: even when something was not her strong point, she would spare no effort to do it for my sake.

units.source_text: 即使是她所不甚得意的艺能，也决不落后地努力下功夫。

en.t: Even in the arts she was not especially good at, she worked hard and would not let herself fall behind.

units.source_text: 凡事都尽心竭力地照顾我，丝毫也不违背我的心愿。

en.t: In everything she cared for me with all her heart and strength, and never went against my wishes in the slightest.

units.source_text: 我虽认为她是个好胜的人，但她总算顺从我，态度日益柔和了。

en.t: Although I thought she was a competitive sort of person, in the end she obeyed me, and her manner grew gentler day by day.

units.source_text: 她惟恐自己相貌不扬，因而失却我的欢心，便勉力修饰；

en.t: Afraid that her plain looks might make her lose my affection, she made every effort to adorn herself;

units.source_text: 又恐被人看见，有伤郎君体面，便处处顾虑，随时躲避。

en.t: and fearing that being seen by others would damage her gentleman's reputation, she was cautious everywhere and kept herself hidden whenever she could.

units.source_text: 总之，无时不刻意讲究自己的打扮。

en.t: In short, she was always deliberately attentive to her appearance.

units.source_text: 我渐渐看惯，觉得她的心地也真不坏。

en.t: As I gradually grew used to her, I came to feel that her nature was truly not bad.

units.source_text: 只是嫉妒一事，却使我不能堪忍。

en.t: Only her jealousy was something I simply could not endure.
